Target complete coverage and independent full output hash equal deliveryContent; exact output MIME/date/reference/leaf/directory/file/usage/owner and no reclaim/reclaimed state. A caller cannot substitute original Log hash for rendition delivery hash.

Live guard rechecks original RecordingIntent.capturedAt through the actual saved record/binding/receipt; finite original calendar date exact, no nil completion. Historic replay uses immutable record facts available then, not future current recordings/registration.

Can reuse CaptureMediaResumeAuthorization.performIfCurrent for the short local latch transition; it is not Wi-Fi/SDKresume permission. No new empty CaptureMediaAdmission is implicitly created.
atomic_commit_API_proposal.lock_order: normal writer transaction -> current capture authorization -> shared import latch -> short synchronous finalizing transition. Hash/read/copy/sourceFDclose/SDK terminal waits completed outside locks. No Task allocation, continuation/yield/callback, await, redispatch, reader open or reentry in action.
atomic_commit_API_proposal.generic_commit_bypass: Generic store.commit of imported stage must failclosed. Document live applyBackend takes an ephemeral authenticated-final flag default false; only concrete guarded final method sets it after fresh predicate + physical witness + capture/latch. Historical applyBackendChange replays the actual new receipt/body without a live permit or I/O.
atomic_commit_API_proposal.temporary_bypass: Response reserves a fresh tempID/usageID and immutable date/type/rendition association before temporary.create. Generic create/acquire for that ID must match the reservation; generic .temporary.verified for ANY new response-reserved ID is rejected. Only atomic imported internal branch may mark verified. Legacy temp IDs with no new reservation keep old rules/encoding.
atomic_commit_API_proposal.loss_and_capture_race: Definite CAS conflict before authorization may re-evaluate with same immutable facts. Unknown/unavailable after attempted commit retains original revision/payload/ref/permit and reconciles exact lookup only. A latch winner followed by disk/lock failure is unknown, not reset to a fresh unstarted operation. Stop wins -> verified0; finalize wins only after all media FDs/workers ended, so later capture sees metadata-only completion. Oldowner/reused permit/ABA cannot become fresh authorization.
atomic_commit_API_proposal.witness_lifetime: The retained import task holds the actual temporary/scope owner through the guarded return or pending exact lookup. Stop revokes the import latch then joins; it never concurrently closes borrowed root/lock descriptors during final checks or reuses numeric FDs. The final latch determines which side wins; no additional filesystem owner is created.

historical_replay_and_namespace: Schema7 additive only. Later current changes may not invalidate a previously valid event. Samewriter final live epoch and physical witness checks apply only to fresh import commit, not old replay.
